sentences.en: I wondered if you could actually describe for me what Aaron looked like the first time you met him.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你能不能描述一下第一次见到亚伦时他是什么样子。

sentences.en: When I met him, the day I met him, I remember he had a green sweatshirt on and the cutest smile, and he looked like a big teddy bear.
sentences.zh: 我见到他那天，我记得他穿着一件绿色运动衫，笑容非常可爱，看起来像一只大泰迪熊。

sentences.en: I knew at the end I was in love with him when I didn't ever want him to leave.
sentences.zh: 我知道我爱上他是在我不想让他离开的时候。

sentences.en: When he would go back to his apartment, all I'd wanted to do was call him.
sentences.zh: 当他要回自己公寓时，我只想给他打电话。

sentences.en: Kim is older than Aaron.
sentences.zh: 金比亚伦大。

sentences.en: She's 48 to his 36.
sentences.zh: 她48岁，他36岁。

sentences.en: They've both been born and raised in this area.
sentences.zh: 他们都是在这个地区出生长大的。

sentences.en: And when they come to find each other, they're inseparable.
sentences.zh: 当他们相遇时，他们就再也没有分开过。

sentences.en: We didn't have a lot of money or anything, so we didn't go out and do a lot of stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们没什么钱，所以我们不怎么出去玩。

sentences.en: But I was pretty sick at the time, so he would take care of me.
sentences.zh: 但我当时病得很重，所以他会照顾我。

sentences.en: And when you say that you were sick at the time, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 当你提到你当时病得很重时，是指什么？

sentences.en: I have a lot of chronic pain issues with my back and my hips, and I have fibromyalgia and
sentences.zh: 我的背部和臀部有很多慢性疼痛问题，我患有纤维肌痛，而且

sentences.en: very good.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: And so she's prescribed prescription fentanyl patches, that synthetic opioid, that she uses to allay some of this pain.
sentences.zh: 所以她被开了芬太尼透皮贴剂，那种合成阿片类药物，她用它来缓解部分疼痛。

sentences.en: And when I was real sick and having bad days and stuff, Aaron would go and get my patches going down
sentences.zh: 当我病得很重、日子很难过的时候，亚伦会去拿我的贴剂，

sentences.en: on the bed, and he would, and then stick it to either my upper arm.
sentences.zh: 在床上，然后他会把它贴在我的上臂上。

sentences.en: But other times, they would split the patch.
sentences.zh: 但有时，他们会把贴剂分开。

sentences.en: They have a little pocket in them with gel inside.
sentences.zh: 它们里面有一个装有凝胶的小袋子。

sentences.en: And if you cut that open, you can scoop it out of there.
sentences.zh: 如果你把它切开，就可以把里面的东西挖出来。

sentences.en: You can eat it.
sentences.zh: 你可以吃掉它。

sentences.en: You can water it down a little bit, and you can shoot it up.
sentences.zh: 你可以把它用水稀释一点，然后注射。

sentences.en: And most of the time, we would eat it.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，我们是吃掉它。

sentences.en: It smelled like rubbing alcohol.
sentences.zh: 它闻起来像外用酒精。

sentences.en: It tasted kind of like rubbing alcohol.
sentences.zh: 尝起来也有点像外用酒精。

sentences.en: And that was to get a much more potent hit of that synthetic fentanyl, and to get high.
sentences.zh: 那是为了获得更强效的合成芬太尼冲击，为了获得快感。

sentences.en: It felt like someone had just been over me that just made all my pain go away because of being so sick all the time.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像有人刚刚在我身边，让我所有的痛苦都消失了，因为我一直病得很重。

sentences.en: I felt like a burden a lot.
sentences.zh: 我经常觉得自己是个负担。

sentences.en: They both had a long history of using drugs and using opioids.
sentences.zh: 他们两人都有很长的吸毒和使用阿片类药物的历史。

sentences.en: Kim came to them during her first marriage many years before, and both of them had been using for many, many years, on and off, trying to stop sometimes, restarting.
sentences.zh: 金在多年前的第一次婚姻中就开始接触这些了，他们两人都已经使用了很多很多年，断断续续，有时试图戒掉，又重新开始。

sentences.en: And the two of you would use together frequently?
sentences.zh: 你们俩经常一起使用吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Like, if one of us had something and the other one had it.
sentences.zh: 就像，如果我们其中一个人有东西，另一个人也有。

sentences.en: When you're a couple and you do drugs, you share.
sentences.zh: 当你是一对情侣并且吸毒时，你们会分享。

sentences.en: That's just how it is.
sentences.zh: 事实就是这样。

sentences.zh: 金，我想请你告诉我2015年12月那个星期六发生了什么。

sentences.zh: 那天发生的事我什么都不记得了。

sentences.en: Aaron wakes up early.

sentences.zh: 他正要和金告别，但首先她拿了一片贴剂，她的一片芬太尼贴剂。

sentences.zh: 她把它撕开。

sentences.zh: 她分了一部分给他。

sentences.en: She keeps part of it for herself.
sentences.zh: 她留了一部分给自己。

sentences.en: They both squeeze the gel out, swallow it.
sentences.zh: 他们都挤出凝胶，吞了下去。

sentences.en: He sticks that half patch in his mouth.
sentences.zh: 他把那半片贴剂放进嘴里。

sentences.en: He's going to head out and she stays home.
sentences.zh: 他准备出发，而她留在家里。

sentences.en: And what happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: In the middle of the day, Kim's adult son, Adam, comes to the house to check on them.
sentences.zh: 当天中午，金的成年儿子亚当来到家里看望他们。

sentences.en: He opens the door.
sentences.zh: 他打开门。

sentences.en: And right in the front hallway lying there is Aaron, fully dressed, holding his bow and not breathing.
sentences.zh: 亚伦就躺在前厅里，穿着整齐，手里拿着弓，已经没有呼吸了。

sentences.en: He comes further into the house, looking for his mom and finds her at the top of the stairs, passed out, gurgling slightly.
sentences.zh: 他往屋里走去寻找他妈妈，发现她在楼梯顶上，昏迷不醒，喉咙里发出轻微的咯咯声。

sentences.en: They've both overdosed.
sentences.zh: 他们都过量服药了。

sentences.en: It sinks in.
sentences.zh: 事实沉重地压在心头。

sentences.en: Adam, her son, takes her back to his house and takes care of her for a couple weeks.
sentences.zh: 她的儿子亚当把她带回自己家，照顾了她几周。

sentences.en: And then she finally is like, I got to go back home.
sentences.zh: 然后她终于说，我得回家了。

sentences.en: I got to face this and take care of myself.
sentences.zh: 我得面对这一切，照顾好自己。

sentences.en: And she opens the door, waiting with all the boxes of the ornaments and stuff that we were decorating, putting the tree up.
sentences.zh: 她打开门，等着那些我们用来装饰、布置圣诞树的装饰品盒子。

sentences.en: And she realizes she's alone.
sentences.zh: 她意识到自己孤身一人。

sentences.zh: 我真的意识到他再也不会走进那扇门了。

sentences.zh: 她在屋子里走来走去。

sentences.zh: 她吃下了所有能找到的药片，并用廉价伏特加送服，试图自杀。

sentences.en: And she wakes up again in the hospital with her son by her side, crying because I can't take it anymore.
sentences.zh: 她再次在医院醒来，儿子守在身边，哭着说我再也受不了了。

sentences.en: She is going to get sober and she is going to recover and get some help.
sentences.zh: 她决定戒毒，她要康复并寻求帮助。

sentences.en: So she checks in to a nearby treatment center and she's starting to get some help.
sentences.zh: 于是她住进了一家附近的治疗中心，开始寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Going over paperwork, the parking lot and we looked at each other and she said, isn't it a nice feeling to know that they aren't here for you?
sentences.zh: 在停车场处理文书工作时，我们对视了一眼，她说，知道他们不再在这里为你服务，这种感觉很好，不是吗？

sentences.en: And I said, oh my gosh, yes.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦天哪，是的。

sentences.en: Called my name and I walked out.

sentences.en: Today, there's a new epidemic.
sentences.zh: 如今，又出现了一种新的流行病。

sentences.en: Smokable cocaine, otherwise known as crack.
sentences.zh: 可吸食的可卡因，也就是俗称的“快克”（crack）。

sentences.en: Crack.
sentences.zh: 快克。

sentences.en: Crack.
sentences.zh: 快克。

sentences.en: A drug so pure and so strong, it might just as well be called crack of doom.
sentences.zh: 这种毒品纯度极高、药效极强，称它为“末日快克”也不为过。

sentences.en: This is a war.
sentences.zh: 这是一场战争。

sentences.en: Len Bias becomes the symbol of the drug epidemic and its destruction.
sentences.zh: 伦·拜亚斯成了毒品流行病及其破坏力的象征。

sentences.en: And the villain in that becomes his friend, Brian Tribble, who provided the cocaine and was using it with him.
sentences.zh: 而其中的反派成了他的朋友布莱恩·特里布尔（Brian Tribble），是他提供了可卡因并与他一起吸食。

sentences.en: And Tribble is charged with providing the cocaine.
sentences.zh: 特里布尔被指控提供可卡因。

sentences.en: He's acquitted.
sentences.zh: 他被判无罪。

sentences.en: But this inspires a flurry of bills and laws that reframe the person who provided drugs in an overdose death as the killer.
sentences.zh: 但这引发了一连串的法案和法律，将那些在过量吸毒致死案中提供毒品的人重新定义为杀人犯。

sentences.en: So even if someone didn't intend to harm this other person, or even if they were doing the drugs together, they can be held criminally accountable for the other person's death.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使某人并没有伤害对方的意图，或者即使他们是一起吸毒，他们也可能要为对方的死亡承担刑事责任。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: If they intended to cause the death, it's just regular murder.
sentences.zh: 如果他们有蓄意谋杀的意图，那自然就是普通的谋杀罪。

sentences.en: This is for people who do not intend to cause a death, but they are being held responsible for the death of someone who voluntarily used drugs and overdosed.
sentences.zh: 但这条法律针对的是那些本无意杀人，却要为自愿吸毒过量致死者承担责任的人。

sentences.en: Police here are cracking down on crack dealers, searching for those selling the newest and most potent drug in town.
sentences.zh: 当地警方正在严厉打击快克毒贩，搜捕那些兜售城里最新、最强效毒品的人。

sentences.en: So these laws were kind of born in a moment of crisis, what politicians were calling crack epidemic in the late 80s.
sentences.zh: 所以这些法律是在危机时刻诞生的，也就是政客们在80年代末所称的“快克流行病”时期。

sentences.en: But the reason I started doing this reporting now is because we're in what they're calling the opioid epidemic.
sentences.zh: 但我现在开始做这个报道的原因是，我们正处于他们所说的“阿片类药物流行病”之中。

sentences.en: And I started to notice from local news reports, a resurgence of this particular tactic, more and more of these kinds of homicide charges being filed.
sentences.zh: 我从当地新闻报道中开始注意到，这种特定的策略正在卷土重来，越来越多的此类杀人指控被提起。

sentences.en: And I decided to try and start actually counting and tracking and seeing how big that resurgence was.
sentences.zh: 于是我决定开始实际统计、追踪，看看这种卷土重来的规模有多大。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm particularly focusing, I'm interested in the lend bias kind of laws, the third degree that you guys have.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我特别关注的是那些“伦·拜亚斯式”的法律，也就是你们那里的三级谋杀罪。

sentences.en: So I spent the last year looking at this and trying to collect data on how much these prosecutions actually were increasing.
sentences.zh: 所以我花了一年时间研究这个问题，试图收集数据，看看这些起诉到底增加了多少。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi, David.
sentences.zh: 你好，大卫。

sentences.en: I was a gold person for the time.
sentences.zh: 我当时是个金牌选手。

sentences.en: Tell me about the story you're working on.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你正在做的报道吧。

sentences.en: Why this trial of all trials in America?
sentences.zh: 为什么偏偏是这起审判？

sentences.en: I talked to 15, nearly 20 district attorneys, prosecutors across the country who are doing these cases.
sentences.zh: 我采访了全国各地15到近20位正在处理这些案件的地区检察官和公诉人。

sentences.en: These reckless homicide drug delivery cases.
sentences.zh: 这些鲁莽杀人及毒品供应案件。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Have you had a lot of those?
sentences.zh: 你们处理过很多这类案件吗？

sentences.en: We have.
sentences.zh: 处理过。

sentences.en: I think most counties in Wisconsin have.
sentences.zh: 我想威斯康星州大多数县都处理过。

sentences.en: And in 15 states where I was able to get official data, they doubled between 2015 and 2017.
sentences.zh: 在我能获得官方数据的15个州里，这类案件在2015年到2017年间翻了一番。

sentences.en: So what's the reasoning behind doing them?
sentences.zh: 那么，进行这些起诉背后的理由是什么？

sentences.en: I want to be able to talk about the pros.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈其中的利弊。

sentences.en: In all these cases, you're trying to achieve the greatest impact.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些案件中，你都是为了追求最大的影响。

sentences.en: You're trying to create the greatest deterrence.
sentences.zh: 你试图产生最大的威慑力。

sentences.en: And those things usually combine in trying to reach back and identify the source.
sentences.zh: 而这些目标通常结合在一起，试图追根溯源，找出源头。

sentences.en: There's not evidence, there's not numerical evidence of any kind that it's having that kind of effect.
sentences.zh: 没有任何证据，没有任何数字证据表明它能产生那种效果。

sentences.en: So are we deterring anything?
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的威慑到了什么吗？

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 我希望如此。

sentences.en: I'm in a small county.
sentences.zh: 我在一个小县城。

sentences.en: I hope that there's some level of deterrence.
sentences.zh: 我希望至少能起到某种程度的威慑作用。

sentences.en: I think they'll say, oh, you're from Twin Lakes.
sentences.zh: 我想他们会说，哦，你是双湖（Twin Lakes）来的。

sentences.en: I'm not telling you.
sentences.zh: 我不能告诉你。

sentences.en: I think they think, you know, they're from, you know, southeast Wisconsin by the border.
sentences.zh: 我想他们认为，你知道，他们来自威斯康星州东南部靠近边界的地方。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: There's been a lot of homicide charges up there.
sentences.zh: 那里已经有很多杀人指控了。

sentences.en: I don't want anything to do with that.
sentences.zh: 我不想和那事扯上关系。

sentences.en: You think that might be going on?
sentences.zh: 你认为可能发生了这种情况吗？

sentences.en: I think that that's a good possibility.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很有可能。

sentences.en: We certainly have seen a reduction.
sentences.zh: 我们确实看到了减少。

sentences.en: Do you feel like it was achieving the ends of supply reduction or deterring people from selling?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这达到了减少供应或威慑毒贩的目的了吗？

sentences.en: You know, I really do.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我真的这么认为。

sentences.en: And, you know, I know that the numbers show that it's going up.
sentences.zh: 而且，我知道数据确实显示案件在增加。

sentences.en: But I am in touch with some of the...
sentences.zh: 但我与一些……保持着联系。

sentences.en: And I heard that repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 我反复听到这种说法。

sentences.en: I think it's working.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很有效。

sentences.en: So there is, I think, a disjunct often between the hopes of people in leadership and people who make policy and the reality on the ground.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为领导层和政策制定者的愿望与现实情况之间往往存在脱节。

sentences.en: I don't know if zealously prosecuting drug dealers for killing kids is going to stop it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道严厉起诉毒贩致人死亡是否真的能阻止这一切。

sentences.en: I just,
sentences.zh: 我只是，

sentences.en: I'm not convinced it will.
sentences.zh: 我不相信它能做到。

sentences.en: Do you see an impact on the street?
sentences.zh: 你在街头看到什么影响了吗？

sentences.en: No, but I don't give a shit.
sentences.zh: 没有，但我根本不在乎。

sentences.en: I went to see this prosecutor named Pete Orpit in Minnesota, not far from where Kim is in prison.
sentences.zh: 我去明尼苏达州见了那位叫皮特·奥皮特（Pete Orpit）的检察官，离金（Kim）服刑的地方不远。

sentences.en: He was really interesting because he doesn't think that this approach will keep dealers from dealing or users from using.
sentences.zh: 他很有意思，因为他不认为这种方法能阻止毒贩贩毒或吸毒者吸毒。

sentences.en: But the goal isn't to go, if I prosecute every guy who gives drugs to another guy and kills them, there won't be a problem anymore?
sentences.zh: 但目标不是说，如果我起诉每一个给别人毒品导致其死亡的人，问题就不会再存在了，对吧？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: We're not that naive.
sentences.zh: 我们没那么天真。

sentences.en: He did it out of a sort of sense of justice and of wanting to do something about this crisis of overdose deaths.
sentences.zh: 他这样做是出于一种正义感，以及想要为这场过量死亡危机做点什么的愿望。

sentences.en: No, we're not out to save the world with that shit, Rosa.
sentences.zh: 不，罗莎，我们不是为了拯救世界才做这些破事。

sentences.en: We can't.
sentences.zh: 我们做不到。

sentences.en: No, seriously, we can't even think about public policy on that.
sentences.zh: 不，说真的，我们甚至不能从公共政策的角度去考虑这个问题。

sentences.en: I look at it just on a very, very narrow view of you owe me for that dead kid.
sentences.zh: 我只是从一个非常、非常狭隘的角度来看待它：那个死去的孩子，你欠我的。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: What were people around you saying about this charge?
sentences.zh: 你周围的人对这项指控怎么说？

sentences.en: What were you hearing from your family and from Aaron's family?
sentences.zh: 你从你的家人和亚伦（Aaron）的家人那里听到了什么？

sentences.en: Nobody could really wrap their mind around the fact that I was even getting this charge.
sentences.zh: 没人能理解我竟然会面临这样的指控。

sentences.en: It didn't make any sense.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: Against me at all was his oldest sister.
sentences.zh: 反对我最强烈的是他的大姐。

sentences.en: Krista Powell.
sentences.zh: 克里斯塔·鲍威尔（Krista Powell）。

sentences.en: I fully understand that Kim did not give him her pain patch in any attempt to do harm.
sentences.zh: 我完全理解金并不是想伤害他才把止痛贴给他的。

sentences.en: I mean, if I get drunk and get behind the wheel and I crash into someone and kill them, that wasn't my intention.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我喝醉了开车，撞死了一个人，那也不是我的本意。

sentences.en: But that person's death is still on me.
sentences.zh: 但那个人的死依然要算在我头上。

sentences.en: So Krista grew up with Aaron and she was very close to him and feels an incredible loss.
sentences.zh: 克里斯塔和亚伦一起长大，她和他非常亲近，感到无比失落。

sentences.en: Aaron and I are about two and a half years apart.
sentences.zh: 我和亚伦只差两岁半。

sentences.en: We had a couple of dogs.
sentences.zh: 我们养了几条狗。

sentences.en: He liked to dress his up, put a t-shirt on, bring the dog in, have popcorn, watch movies with the dog.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢给狗打扮，给它们穿T恤，带狗进来，吃爆米花，和狗一起看电影。

sentences.en: A real animal lover.
sentences.zh: 一个真正的动物爱好者。

sentences.en: Krista, what do you think it was growing up that brought you so close to Aaron?
sentences.zh: 克里斯塔，你觉得成长过程中是什么让你和亚伦如此亲近？

sentences.en: Aaron.
sentences.zh: 亚伦。

sentences.en: We grew up in a house of domestic violence and my parents turned to addictions and there's not a whole lot of people in your circle of friends that understand what it's like
sentences.zh: 我们在一个充满家庭暴力的家庭中长大，我的父母沉迷于毒瘾，你的朋友圈里没有多少人能理解那种感觉。

sentences.en: to be the child of an addict.
sentences.zh: 成为瘾君子的孩子是什么滋味。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, when I was in high school and my dad's in jail, you know, there's not anybody in your science class that really gets that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我在上高中，我爸爸在坐牢时，科学课上没人能真正理解这一点。

sentences.en: But Aaron did.
sentences.zh: 但亚伦懂。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And where were you when you first found out that the police were treating Aaron's death as a murder?
sentences.zh: 当你第一次发现警方将亚伦的死视为谋杀案处理时，你在哪里？

sentences.en: I was actually in my kitchen and the investigator called me just so that he wanted to let me
sentences.zh: 我当时正在厨房里，调查员给我打了电话，他只是想在

sentences.en: know before I found out from the news that Kim was being arrested for third degree homicide.
sentences.zh: 我从新闻里得知金因三级谋杀罪被捕之前，先通知我一声。

sentences.en: And what did you think when you heard that?
sentences.zh: 当你听到这个消息时，你是怎么想的？

sentences.en: That it sounded really serious.
sentences.zh: 觉得这事真的很严重。

sentences.en: I mean, I got off the phone and I Googled it and I went,
sentences.zh: 我挂了电话，上网搜了一下，然后我想，

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That's exactly what she did.
sentences.zh: 这正是她所做的。

sentences.en: So I won't lie.
sentences.zh: 所以我不会撒谎。

sentences.en: I was glad.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴。

sentences.en: You were glad she was being charged?
sentences.zh: 你很高兴她被起诉了？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because my brother lost 40 years of his life and the actions of one person caused that.
sentences.zh: 因为我弟弟失去了40年的生命，而一个人的行为导致了这一切。

sentences.en: Krista, what do you say to people who say that this is just what drug users do?
sentences.zh: 克里斯塔，你对那些说“这就是吸毒者会做的事”的人怎么说？

sentences.en: They share drugs.
sentences.zh: 他们分享毒品。

sentences.en: And it very easily could have been Aaron who provided the drugs and the roles could have been reversed.
sentences.zh: 而且很有可能提供毒品的人是亚伦，角色完全可能互换。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, like I said, I just, I know in this case that it was her prescription and she admitted giving it to him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就像我说的，我只知道在这个案子里，那是她的处方药，而且她承认给了他。

sentences.en: But yeah, you're right.
sentences.zh: 但是的，你说得对。

sentences.en: And if the roles were reversed, obviously, you know, my knee-jerk reaction should be the same exact thing, you know?
sentences.zh: 如果角色互换，显然，你知道，我的第一反应应该是一模一样的，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But he is my brother.
sentences.zh: 但他是我弟弟。

sentences.en: But I can't say that I would expect to want it to all go away.
sentences.zh: 但我不能说我希望这一切就这么算了。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Would you want your brother charged?
sentences.zh: 你会希望你弟弟被起诉吗？

sentences.en: I would want, yes, I would.
sentences.zh: 我会希望，是的，我会。

sentences.en: I feel that if that was the point where he was at with his addiction, that maybe this would be the wake-up call he needed.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果那是他毒瘾发作的节点，也许这就是他所需要的警钟。

sentences.en: To be charged with murder.
sentences.zh: 被指控谋杀。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, my whole point here is to advocate for another family not dealing with the grief that my family has and is dealing with.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我在这里的全部意义在于呼吁其他家庭不要再经历我家人正在经历的这种悲痛。

sentences.en: I don't know what else we as a society can do to deter it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我们作为一个社会还能做些什么来威慑它。

sentences.en: But the data doesn't necessarily show that these charges are deterring people from using or borrowing drugs.
sentences.zh: 但数据并不一定显示这些指控能阻止人们使用或分享毒品。

sentences.en: So if the charge doesn't have a deterrent effect, would you still want to see people like
sentences.zh: 所以，如果指控没有威慑作用，你是否仍然希望看到像

sentences.en: Kim getting charged with a crime like murder?
sentences.zh: 金这样的人被指控谋杀罪？

sentences.en: I mean, the fact remains that, you know, someone lost a life.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，事实仍然是，你知道，有人失去了一条生命。

sentences.en: And, I mean, if we just didn't charge Kim because Aaron was an addict, then that meant that his death was of no importance.
sentences.zh: 而且，我的意思是，如果我们因为亚伦是个瘾君子就不起诉金，那就意味着他的死毫无意义。

sentences.en: You know, big deal.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: 36-year-old healthy man died.
sentences.zh: 一个36岁的健康男人死了。

sentences.en: And my brother's life meant something.
sentences.zh: 而我兄弟的生命是有意义的。

sentences.en: Is there a lot of pressure on DAs to do these kinds of cases?
sentences.zh: 地方检察官在处理这类案件时压力很大吗？

sentences.en: No, there's none.
sentences.zh: 不，完全没有。

sentences.en: From the public or not?
sentences.zh: 来自公众的压力呢？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Public doesn't care.
sentences.zh: 公众并不关心。

sentences.en: It reminds me of a murdered prostitute.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了一个被谋杀的妓女。

sentences.en: Oh, boy, that's a shame, but tough shit.
sentences.zh: 天哪，那确实很遗憾，但那又怎样，活该。

sentences.en: She lives a risky lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 她过着高风险的生活方式。

sentences.en: What are you going to do?
sentences.zh: 你能怎么办呢？

sentences.en: What do you think you're going to get?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你能得到什么结果？

sentences.en: There's that attitude.
sentences.zh: 你看，这就是那种态度。

sentences.en: And that's what they'd say with the junkie.
sentences.zh: 他们对瘾君子也是这么说的。

sentences.en: That's why we don't do drugs.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们不碰毒品。

sentences.en: Yeah, but that's a lot of victim blaming and a lot of throwing your own moral values on it.
sentences.zh: 是啊，但这其中包含了很多受害者有罪论，也掺杂了太多你个人的道德评判。

sentences.en: That's not, we're getting away from our job.
sentences.zh: 不是这样的，我们不能偏离自己的工作职责。

sentences.en: You know, I'm not the county moraliSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不是县里的道德法官。

sentences.en: I think that the families of people who use drugs anticipate for their loved one's death to be meaningless or even made fun of.
sentences.zh: 我认为吸毒者的家人其实预料到，他们亲人的离世会被视为毫无意义，甚至会被人嘲笑。

sentences.en: They're expecting their community and the rest of the world not to see it as important, to see it as expected, to even say good riddance because that person used drugs.
sentences.zh: 他们预料到社区和外界不会觉得这很重要，只会觉得这是意料之中的事，甚至会说“死得好”，就因为那个人吸毒。

sentences.en: And so when the police and a judge and the courts and everyone suddenly
sentences.zh: 所以，当警察、法官、法院以及所有人突然

sentences.en: cares, that means a lot to them.
sentences.zh: 开始关心时，这对他们来说意义重大。

sentences.en: It's legitimating.
sentences.zh: 这是一种认可。

sentences.en: Krista, there may be people who hear this and think to themselves, there's so much suffering here.
sentences.zh: 克里斯塔，有些人听到这些可能会想，这里面有太多的痛苦了。

sentences.en: And that charging someone with murder who herself is suffering with addiction just perpetuates that suffering.
sentences.zh: 而且，以谋杀罪起诉一个同样深受毒瘾折磨的人，只会让这种痛苦延续下去。

sentences.en: And that true accountability when it comes to addiction lies with a whole group of people
sentences.zh: 真正的问责制，当涉及到毒瘾问题时，应该指向那一整群人，

sentences.en: who are way up high in an industry that creates these drugs and distributes them and makes it possible for people to abuse them.
sentences.zh: 那些在行业高层制造这些毒品、分销这些毒品，并让人们能够滥用它们的人。

sentences.en: What do you think about that?
sentences.zh: 你对此怎么看？

sentences.en: I mean, I won't argue with the fact that a lot of the prescription drug issues have been created by
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不会否认这样一个事实：很多处方药问题是由

sentences.en: overprescribing.
sentences.zh: 过度开药造成的。

sentences.en: And if you find a way to restructure the industry so that we aren't letting drugs get in
sentences.zh: 如果你能找到一种方法来重组这个行业，让我们不再让毒品落入

sentences.en: the hands of the wrong people to be distributed to even more of the wrong people, I will jump on board.
sentences.zh: 错误的人手中，并进一步分销给更多错误的人，我绝对支持。

sentences.en: But until then, this is the only way I know how to try and save another family from the pain and grief that my family deals with.
sentences.zh: 但在那之前，这是我唯一知道的方法，希望能拯救另一个家庭，让他们免受我家人所承受的痛苦和悲伤。

sentences.en: So Kim feels like the most accessible person to hold accountable here.
sentences.zh: 所以金感觉像是这里最容易被问责的人。

sentences.en: That's one way of putting it.
sentences.zh: 你可以这么说。

sentences.en: Rosie, when we hold people like Kim accountable in these deaths, who aren't we holding accountable?
sentences.zh: 罗西，当我们让像金这样的人为这些死亡负责时，我们没有让谁负责呢？

sentences.en: Who are we not blaming?
sentences.zh: 我们没有指责谁？

sentences.en: You know, we're not blaming the health care system, the insurance industry that is not adequately treating people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们没有指责医疗保健系统，也没有指责那些没有为人们提供充分治疗的保险行业。

sentences.en: We're not dealing with how people are self-medicating with painkillers and the industry that has profited off that.
sentences.zh: 我们没有去处理人们是如何通过止痛药进行自我治疗的，也没有去处理那些从中获利的行业。

sentences.en: And we're not able to grapple with the kind of deeper why of substance use and all the kind of social and economic and personal factors that are really causing the crisis.
sentences.zh: 我们无法深入探讨药物滥用背后的深层原因，以及导致这场危机的各种社会、经济和个人因素。

sentences.en: We can't deal with that and with what some people call deaths of despair.
sentences.zh: 我们无法处理这些问题，也无法处理某些人所说的“绝望之死”。

sentences.en: Instead, we're looking to the person closest by who put the pills, the powder, the patch into someone else's hands that we can get our mind around.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们只盯着身边最容易触及的那个人，是她把药片、粉末、贴片交到了别人手里，这是我们能理解的层面。

sentences.en: Do you think that you hurt, Erin?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你受伤了吗，艾琳？

sentences.en: I'm trying to find the responsibility in it.
sentences.zh: 我正在努力寻找其中的责任所在。

sentences.en: And the drugs, I should not have shared drugs.
sentences.zh: 还有毒品，我不该分享毒品的。

sentences.en: If we get right down to the point of law, he shared all kinds of drugs.
sentences.zh: 如果我们严格按照法律条文来看，他分享了各种各样的毒品。

sentences.en: And he shared all kinds of drugs with me.
sentences.zh: 而且他也和我分享了各种各样的毒品。

sentences.en: Do you think that you, do you think you're starting to internalize a little bit what the state is saying about you, that you are responsible for Erin's death?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你，你觉得你是否开始在潜意识里接受了州政府对你的指控，认为你该为艾琳的死负责？

sentences.en: Kimberly Elkins was charged with third-degree murder in the death of Erin Ross, but pled guilty to manslaughter and is serving a four-year prison sentence in Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 金伯利·埃尔金斯因艾琳·罗斯的死亡被控三级谋杀，但她承认了过失杀人罪，目前正在明尼苏达州服四年刑期。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: I had a very, very interesting morning.
sentences.zh: 我度过了一个非常、非常有趣的早晨。

sentences.en: President Trump says he spoke with four candidates to replace Justice Anthony Kennedy on the Supreme Court
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表示，他已经与四位候选人进行了交谈，以接替最高法院大法官安东尼·肯尼迪，

sentences.en: as the White House races to meet Trump's deadline of announcing a pick by next Monday.
sentences.zh: 白宫正争分夺秒地赶在特朗普下周一宣布人选的截止日期前完成工作。

sentences.en: They are outstanding people.
sentences.zh: 他们都是杰出的人才。

sentences.en: They are really incredible people in so many different ways, academically and every other way.
sentences.zh: 他们在很多方面都非常出色，无论是在学术上还是在其他任何方面。

sentences.en: The White House declined to say with whom the president met, but the short list of candidates is believed to include six federal appeals court judges.
sentences.zh: 白宫拒绝透露总统会见了谁，但据信候选人名单中包括六名联邦上诉法院法官。

sentences.en: I think the person that is chosen will be outstanding.
sentences.zh: 我认为被选中那个人将会非常出色。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, everybody.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And President Trump's longtime lawyer, Michael Cohen, who is under investigation for secret payments
sentences.zh: 而特朗普总统的长期律师迈克尔·科恩，因涉嫌向声称与总统有染的女性支付秘密款项而受到调查，

sentences.en: to women who said they had affairs with the president, is signaling a new willingness to cooperate with federal prosecutors, even if it undermines Trump.
sentences.zh: 他正释放出一种新的意愿，愿意与联邦检察官合作，即使这会损害特朗普的利益。

sentences.en: In an off-camera interview with ABC's George Stephanopoulos, Cohen was asked what he would do
sentences.zh: 在接受美国广播公司乔治·斯蒂芬诺普洛斯的非摄像采访时，科恩被问及如果检察官强迫他在家人和特朗普之间做出选择，他会怎么做，

sentences.en: if prosecutors forced him to choose between his family and Trump, who, in the past, Cohen has said he would take a bullet for.
sentences.zh: 毕竟科恩过去曾说过他愿意为特朗普挡子弹。

sentences.en: I put family and country first, Cohen replied.
sentences.zh: “我把家庭和国家放在第一位，”科恩回答道。

sentences.en: To be crystal clear, my wife, my daughter, and my son, and this country, have my first loyalty.
sentences.zh: “说得再清楚一点，我的妻子、我的女儿、我的儿子，还有这个国家，才是我最优先效忠的对象。”

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Thursday, after the holiday.
sentences.zh: 周四假期后再见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和萨拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在你获取播客的任何地方收听。

sentences.en: What are our successful heart-цу-ness?
sentences.zh: 我们成功的秘诀是什么？

sentences.en: The two of us are great to build her fandom.
sentences.zh: 我们两个非常擅长建立她的粉丝群。
